rationale: The already pre-registered same-timing KODEX 200 comparator showed that low-turnover risk timing added value while concentrated stock selection did not. The new untested component is a fixed leveraged-ETF risk budget intended to add upside without stock-specific ranking or frequent rebalancing.

signals.risk_state: frozen K200LowTurnoverReentry defaults using only KODEX 200 split-adjusted history
signals.execution: state changes execute at the following session open

execution.cash_distributions: official payment events with 15.4 percent withholding on the taxable amount

decision_rule: Any development gate failure rejects v1 without opening either sealed period. Passing development opens only the 2023-2024 walk-forward period.
